limitations: These boxes conservatively enclose authored INPUT vertices and any convex hull built from those points. They are not decoded PhysX cooked shapes and do not certify padding/decomposition/contact offsets.
Boxes can overestimate robot occupied material and fill concavities. Rotation into world must use each named link FK frame; a static box is not an environment clearance sensor.
USD metadata metersPerUnit0.01 is not multiplied again: explicit authored mesh scales and metre-sized link transforms are applied once, matching existing robot reference semantics.
No robot radius or arbitrary safety margin was invented; bounds are actual extrema of supplied input vertices.
Only robot-own static geometry is included. No target, seat, instrument, obstacle or historical contact state is present.
